partes.enunciado: forall x : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) C, qubitReduction x = diagExpect x

plusDensity.rank = 1 and (qubitReduction plusDensity).rank = 2 and (qubitReduction plusDensity).trace = plusDensity.trace
